description: 比较 ID，对应 experiment.yaml
name: contrast_id

description: disease_effect / treatment_effect / time_effect / other
name: contrast_role

description: 组织
name: tissue

description: 组学
name: omics

description: 特征 ID，类型见 dataset.json；MFA 为反应 ID
name: feature_id

description: 特征名称
name: feature_name

description: 分子组相对分母组的 log2 倍数变化；均值接近 0 或跨 0 时可为空
name: log2fc

description: 效应量；MFA 必填
name: effect_size

description: 如 hedges_g
name: effect_size_type

description: 检验统计量
name: statistic

description: 主检验的 p 值；只给效应量时为空
name: pvalue

description: 主检验的校正后 p 值
name: padj

description: 校正方法，如 fdr_bh；未校正时为 none
name: padj_method

description: 分子组实际参与检验的生物学重复数
name: n_numerator

description: 分母组实际参与检验的生物学重复数
name: n_denominator

description: 秩检验在该样本量下可达到的最小 p 值
name: min_achievable_p

description: 检验方法或证据路径，如 deseq2、limma、ttest、effect_size_only
name: method

description: 分子组均值；MFA 必填，单位见 units
name: mean_numerator

description: 分母组均值；MFA 必填
name: mean_denominator

description: 均值的单位；MFA 必填，如 nmol/min/g tissue
name: units

description: 推断单位，如 biological_replicate；MFA 必填
name: inference_unit

description: statistical_test / effect_size_only / insufficient；MFA 必填
name: evidence_level

description: 是否按 selection_rule 入选
name: selected

description: 入选规则的文字描述
name: selection_rule

description: MFA：通量可辨识性分档，如 well_constrained / bound_pinned
name: identifiability

description: MFA：拟合贴在约束边界的动物比例
name: frac_at_bound

description: MFA：生物学稳定性校准的入选概率
name: selection_probability

description: MFA：重抽样下方向一致的比例
name: direction_stability

description: MFA：置换检验 p 值
name: permutation_pvalue

description: 以分号分隔的标记，如 low_n;underpowered;effect_size_undefined
name: flags
